title: Point-hyperplane incidences
exact_target: Find the largest number of incidences between real points and hyperplanes when specified complete bipartite subgraphs are forbidden, especially the balanced case with forbidden $K_{d,d}$.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3800005 (AMR-037-0005). CC BY 4.0.
Aleksa Milojević, Benny Sudakov and István Tomon, Incidence bounds via extremal graph theory (2024), Introduction and §1.1, pp.1–4.
